question: What has been made manifest to the speaker today?
premises: jñānasya nirṇayam deva adya me prakaṭīkṛtam
the determination of knowledge is made manifest
it is addressed to god and given to me
inference: The determination of knowledge has been made manifest to the speaker today.
uncertainties: whether deva is vocative or nominative
plain_english: Today the determination of knowledge has been made manifest to me, O god.
